featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited Creamchills Ice Cream and had a really great experience. The ice cream quality is excellent — rich, creamy, and full of flavor. They have a wide variety of options, from classic favorites to some unique and creative combinations.

featured_reviews.name: eat or regret
featured_reviews.review_text: Gelatos here are creamy, smooth and velvety. This place is just 5 min walking from Bhandup station and they have a wide variety of Gelatos available. We started with best seller Fudge brownie gelato and let me tell you it's even more heavenly in taste then it looks. Seasonal special Sitafal Gelato was great. We then tried Dark Choco Chip thick shake and now it is my favourite. We also tried the Refreshing flavors of Jamaica and Kachi Kairi Popsicles. The show stopper was the Brownie and Fudge Sauce Sundae.

featured_reviews.review_text: Taste and Quality of the ingredients that is used in Scoop are top notch this review is posted after tasting their entire menu 😂 their seasonal in-creams are  too good recently they got tadgola and mango which have real chunks of fruits also their snickers mud chocolate lotus biscoff blueberry cheesecake flavours are worth trying many options are also avail in popsicles which are very cheap considering the taste and quality

featured_reviews.name: Hareena Nafisa
featured_reviews.review_text: It's our go to place for when we have sweet tooth and cravings for ice cream. Absolutely in love with their seasonal ice cream like mango, strawberry and sitaphal. They even have variety of ice creams which are also droolworthy and a must to try on like watermelon, chickoo, malai, tender coconut and especially chocolate chips. Also, they server icecream made from dry fruits like kaju kismis, roasted almond and much more. They server icecream in cups which consist of single as well as double scoop or else people can also go for their family pack options. They do serve icecream in cones like the normal one and also waffle cone. During summers it's a perfect thing to try on.

featured_reviews.name: shilpi arora
featured_reviews.review_text:
Caution - The service of this place is awful. Ordered icecream at 10:30pm and received it at 11:40pm, and that too called the place 3-4 times and every time they would tell me it is coming in 10 mins and their 10minutes turned out to be 70 minutes.
No doubt they serve one of the best icecreams.
I love their sitaphal ice cream.

Food -
Tender coconut - 5/5
Since sitaphal is not in the season, thought of trying something new and ordered tender coconut and it has become my new favourite now. The pieces of coconut in the icecream just adds up to the taste and if you like coconut water then you will surely love this one.

Price - 4/5
The price for half kg tub was 250 bucks,which i think is justified.

Service - 1/5
Wretched.

The staff is polite, attentive, and quick to serve, making the overall experience smooth and pleasant. The owner is friendly and approachable, clearly focused on maintaining quality and customer satisfaction. You can really feel the care and passion behind the brand.
Prices are reasonable and totally worth the quality. It’s a perfect spot for a quick dessert treat with friends or family.

If you’re in Bhandup West and craving great waffles, Creamy Waffle is a must-try..

featured_reviews.name: Atul Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ice Cream Works Gold immediately impresses with its very good seating and inviting ambiance. It's a comfortable spot that makes for a pleasant break during a shopping trip. They offer a really good variety of options, both in terms of diverse flavors and the different kinds of servings (including excellent choices for kids!).

The Flavor Breakdown
The selection here is truly impressive, appealing to many different palates:

Toasted, Roasted, Burnt Caramel: This flavor was the absolute standout, earning a rare 5 out of 5. Even for someone who isn't a fan of caramel, the texture was perfect and the flavor was deeply satisfying—a must-try!

Madagascar Chocolate: A solid, high-quality chocolate option that scored a commendable 4 out of 5.

70% Dark Chocolate Ganache: This is for the serious dark chocolate enthusiast. It delivers a very strong flavor that initially hits hard, though it had a noticeable aftertaste, bringing the rating to a 3 out of 5 for me personally.

Amanera Black Cherries from Modena: This had a very distinct flavour that ultimately rated a 3 out of 5. It's certainly unique, but perhaps not universally appealing.

Popsicles
The popsicle options also delivered some fantastic results:

Passion Fruit Mango Popsicle: Another perfect 5 out of 5 flavor! The combination was vibrant, with excellent, true fruit flavors.

Frozen Hot Chocolate Popsicle: This was a decent option but didn't quite reach the heights of the others, coming in at a 3 out of 5.

Overall Verdict
Ice Cream Works offers a fantastic ice cream experience with both a delightful setting and a creative, high-quality menu. While the deep, bold flavors—especially the Toasted, Roasted, Burnt Caramel and the Passion Fruit Mango Popsicle—are worth the visit alone. It's a highly recommended stop for a diverse and indulgent dessert!

featured_reviews.name: Shumaila Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We paid ₹735 for this bowl of just 6 pieces, and it was honestly one of the most disappointing dessert experiences we’ve had.

The concept looks attractive, and the ice creams are shaped like fruits, but that’s pretty much where the excitement ends. The outer shell was made of white chocolate that didn’t taste premium or particularly good, and none of the pieces had any real fruity flavour. Whether it was the banana, raspberry, orange, or any other shape, they all tasted almost the same.

What was even more disappointing was the filling. Instead of rich fruit-based ice cream or sorbet, it was mostly plain vanilla-flavoured cream with very little to no fruit flavour inside. The appearance creates an expectation of distinct fruit flavours, but the taste simply doesn’t deliver.

For ₹735, you can get far better desserts, artisanal ice creams, or premium gelato elsewhere. The quality, flavour, and overall experience do not justify the price being charged.

If you’re considering visiting because of the unique look or social media appeal, I’d recommend saving your money and trying something else.
